name: obsidian
description: Turn PDFs and web clippings into a maintained Obsidian knowledge base: name and file PDFs, split books into chapters, extract figures, create evidence-grounded reading notes for papers, chapters, reports, standards and publication notices, clean clippings, build interlinked wiki entries, and keep the vault linted and navigable.

interface.shortDescription: Turn documents and clippings into a maintained Obsidian vault
interface.longDescription: Turn PDFs and web clippings into a maintained Obsidian knowledge base: name and file PDFs, split books into chapters, extract figures, create evidence-grounded reading notes for papers, chapters, reports, standards and publication notices, clean clippings, build interlinked wiki entries, and keep the vault linted and navigable.
defaultPrompt: Organize the PDFs and process the web clippings in my Obsidian inbox.
Summarize a research paper with its key figures in my Obsidian vault.
Audit the wiki entries and rebuild my maps of content.
